sentences.text: 3.  As per allegations made in FIR which was lodged by victim herself, she was married with Harish Chandra Kunkal in the year 2019.
The differences arose between her husband and her so she came back to her house in Bihar and further in marriage ceremony of her relative, Raj Agnihotri @ Satish @ Alex came in her contact.
He was brother of his sister-in-law in the relation and both began to love each other.
Chatting and video calls were also exchanged.
In January 2022, he called her to Jamshedpur in a hotel where he established physical relations with her on the pretext of marriage.
She also disclosed in regard to these affair to her previous husband who raised no objection for the same.

Thereafter, he the accused who had clicked the video of the informant in order to make the same viral he continued to blackmail her and also established physical relations with her many Raj Agnihotri @ Satish @ Alex vs The State Of Jharkhand .... .... sentences.text: Further he refused to marry and also made the video viral to her several known persons in order to defame her.
Ultimately this FIR was lodged.
4. As per allegations made in the FIR, victim was major and married lady.
She knew the consequence of establishing physical relation with the present petitioner without solemnization of marriage.
The thorough conduct of the informant shows that she was consenting party.
So far as blackmailing the informant/victim to make viral her video is concerned, for the same there is no evidence.

5. It has been jointly submitted by the learned counsel for the petitioner and also learned counsel for the informant/victim that a compromise has arrived between the parties and victim and the present petitioner have decided to get married.
The compromise is made annexure of the supplementary-affidavit filed on behalf of the petitioner in this bail petition.
6. In view of the above the bail application of the applicant is hereby allowed.

Let the applicant be released on bail on furnishing bail bond of Rs.25,000/-(Rupees Twenty Five Thousand) with two sureties of the like amount to the satisfaction of the court concerned in aforesaid case.
(Subhash Chand, J.) RKM Raj Agnihotri @ Satish @ Alex vs The State Of Jharkhand .... .... Opp. ... on 13 August, 2024
